blind.description: A square dressed stone post or parapet corner pillar. It consists of a stepped, chamfered square base, a central vertical shaft with recessed panels and framed stone masonry, a protruding molded cornice cap, and a low pyramidal stone roof/capstone. The texture is aged, weathered dressed stone with subtle moss or lichen greening. Surfaces are completely solid, watertight, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: A square profile with concentric stepped square borders surrounding a central square pyramid with an 'X'-like ridge pattern converging at the center peak.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall), and about 1.5 feet wide across the base.
